pages.task: School owner/counselor decides which panel type fits and starts creating a free panel
pages.summary: Clear copy, but the four type cards look selectable and are not, and the single CTA far below them drops the choice the user just made.

findings.issue: The four purpose cards (school, organisation, clinic, solo) are styled like option tiles but are plain <article>s; the only action, «ساخت پنل», sits after all four cards (about 1,000 px down on a phone) and does not carry the type, so the user picks the type again on /my/workspaces/new.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability for the task; ISO 9241-110 conformity with user expectations; Nielsen 4 consistency
findings.fix: Make each card a link to cta_url + '?kind=school|org|clinic|solo' (button «ساخت پنل مدرسه» etc. inside each card) and preselect the radio on tpl_panel_new from the query; keep «شرایط استفاده» as a text link under the grid.

findings.issue: Gated purposes are explained as «پس از بررسی و تأیید» without a time expectation or what happens meanwhile; school card says «بلافاصله فعال می‌شود» but nothing says the account is created with mobile OTP first.
findings.fix: Add one line under the grid: «اول با شمارهٔ موبایل وارد می‌شوید، بعد نام و نوع پنل را می‌نویسید. بررسی پنل سازمان و درمانگاه معمولاً … روز کاری طول می‌کشد.» (time span = owner).

pages.task: Panel owner reads the terms before ticking acceptance
pages.summary: Readable, plain terms; terminology drifts (آزمون, مراجع, لاگ ممیزی) and the version has no human date.

findings.issue: One concept, several words: «آزمون‌های تکمیل‌شده» (vs سنجه), «مراجع‌ها» (vs شرکت‌کننده), «لاگ ممیزی» and «ممیزی» (vs دفتر ممیزی / «گزارش رویدادها» on /help/panel), «کارشناس» (vs عضو/مشاور).
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 consistency; project term list (سنجه, شرکت‌کننده, دفتر ممیزی, پنل)
findings.fix: Replace in tpl_panel_terms: آزمون→سنجه, مراجع/مراجع‌ها→شرکت‌کننده/شرکت‌کنندگان, «لاگ ممیزی»/«ممیزی»→«دفتر ممیزی», کارشناس→«عضو پنل». Bump version (text change).

findings.issue: Version is shown only as code «panel-terms-1405-07-v2»; no Solar Hijri date of effect.
findings.fix: «نسخهٔ ۲، از ۷ مهر ۱۴۰۵» with the code kept in <bdi dir=ltr> after it.

pages.task: Student, counselor or owner signs in or creates an account with a mobile OTP
pages.summary: Short one-field form, but the page tells most users their own sign-in method is weak, repeats the label, and skips a heading level.

findings.issue: Above the form a warning says SMS sign-in is weaker than email and invites users to switch; for a 15-year-old with no email this undermines trust in the only path offered, and it is the second paragraph before the field.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 user engagement (trust); ISO 9241-112 freedom from distraction
findings.fix: Move #ts-sms-risk under the form as a ts-hint and reword neutrally: «اگر حساب ایمیلی دارید، می‌توانید با ایمیل و گذرواژه هم وارد شوید.» Keep the security disclosure on /my/sessions or /my/privacy.

findings.issue: Card heading h3 «شمارهٔ موبایل» directly above the field label «شمارهٔ موبایل» (duplicate), and the h1 is followed by h3 (report: heading-skip h1>h3).
findings.fix: Drop the h3 in the default step (or make it h2 «گام ۱ از ۲: شمارهٔ موبایل»); same h3→h2 for the code and name steps.

findings.issue: No step indication: the user does not know a 6-digit code and then a name step follow (3 steps for new users).
findings.evidence: web_sms.xml:123-156 (steps code, name, phone without a stepper)
findings.fix: Add a small «گام ۱ از ۲» caption per step and under the button: «یک کد ۶ رقمی برایتان پیامک می‌شود.»

pages.summary: Clean Persian form; blank gap above the fields and the switch-to-SMS links drop the return address.

findings.issue: Links «ورود با کد پیامکی» and «ثبت‌نام با موبایل» point to bare /signup, losing ?redirect=; a participant coming from /invite/<token> or /c/<token> who switches to SMS lands on /my instead of back on the invitation.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 controllability; WCAG 2.2 3.3.7 redundant entry (re-finding the link)
findings.fix: t-attf-href="/signup#{'?next=' + url_quote(redirect) if redirect else ''}" on both links.

findings.issue: About 80 px of empty space between the intro and the email field (an emptied stock block), making the form look broken on desktop.
findings.fix: Hide the leftover stock container (passkey/oauth wrapper) inside .ts-auth__card or remove it with an xpath in login_ts.

pages.task: Email user requests a password reset link
pages.summary: Stock Odoo page: English title and buttons, no heading or instructions, card glued to the left screen edge on phones.

findings.issue: English UI on an auth path: tab title «Reset password», «- or -», «Use a Passkey»; no h1, no sentence saying what will happen (report: h1=0; EN Passkey,or).
findings.standard: WCAG 2.2 2.4.2, 2.4.6, 3.1.2; ISO 9241-110 self-descriptiveness; Persian/RTL no English UI
findings.fix: Add ts_website/views/auth.xml record inheriting auth_signup.reset_password (website_ts, priority 99) like login_ts: h1 «بازیابی گذرواژه», hint «پیوند تغییر گذرواژه به ایمیلتان فرستاده می‌شود. اگر با موبایل ثبت‌نام کرده‌اید، گذرواژه ندارید؛ با کد پیامکی وارد شوید.», remove the passkey block, additional_title «بازیابی گذرواژه»; Persian success/error messages.

findings.issue: The card starts at x=0 (no 16 px gutter on the reading-end side) while the other auth pages keep it.
findings.fix: Wrap the stock form in .ts-auth > .ts-auth__card (same markup as login_ts) so the shared padding applies.

pages.task: Panel member finds a short answer about invites, sharing, minors, exports
pages.summary: Useful task-based help with a jump list; terminology differs from terms and panel UI.

findings.issue: Calls the audit trail «گزارش رویدادها» (and «گزارش رویدادهای پنل») while terms say «لاگ ممیزی» and the panel nav says «دفتر ممیزی»/audit.
findings.fix: Use «دفتر ممیزی» everywhere and link it to /my/workspaces/<id>/audit when signed in.

findings.issue: Section h2s render at hero size and wrap to two lines on 375 (e.g. «وارد کردن فهرست شرکت‌کنندگان»), so each answer starts below the fold of its card.
findings.fix: In web_help.xml use class h4 on the section h2s (as tpl_panel_terms does).

pages.task: Student/parent/counselor learns what the talent inventory is and starts it
pages.summary: Honest limits and purpose, but audience says adult, time is wrong for a matrix instrument, two equal CTAs, and dimension cards break in dark mode.

findings.issue: In dark mode the five dimension cards keep a light background while their headings use the dark-theme accent, so headings drop to about 2:1 (report: contrast span 2.0).
findings.evidence: report.txt row 21; _assessments_375_dark.png (cards هوش تحلیلی … کنش وظیفه‌مندی)
findings.fix: Give the dimension card class background: var(--color-surface) and heading color var(--color-accent-300) from tokens, no hard-coded #fff; re-check both themes.

findings.issue: Meta says «حدود ۸ دقیقه» while the player says «هر زمینه حدود یک دقیقه» and the user writes 2-8 fields (30-120 ratings); audience chip says «بزرگسال (پاسخ‌دهی شخصی)» although the product targets students 15+.
findings.evidence: _assessments_1280.txt lines 17-20; consent text «هر زمینه حدود یک دقیقه»
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 conformity with expectations; ISO 25010 appropriateness recognisability
findings.fix: In tpl_detail_ext replace duration with «۲ تا ۸ زمینه، حدود ۲ دقیقه برای هر زمینه»; set the instrument audience (data) to «نوجوان ۱۵+ و بزرگسال».

findings.issue: Two adjacent buttons of equal weight «شروع سنجه» and «ساخت حساب کاربری» both lead into sign-in for a logged-out visitor.
findings.standard: Project rule one primary action; ISO 9241-112 discriminability
findings.fix: Keep only «شروع سنجه» (primary) for logged-out users and turn the account sentence below into the explanation; drop the second button.

pages.task: Prospective owner clicks «ساخت پنل» and must sign in first
pages.summary: Expected redirect to /signup, but the sign-in page gives no hint that the panel creation continues after sign-in.

findings.issue: Redirect is expected, but the landing page is the generic «ورود یا ثبت‌نام با موبایل»; nothing says «برای ساخت پنل اول وارد شوید», so a user who came from /panel thinks the click did the wrong thing.
findings.fix: In tpl_signup show a ts-notice when next is set: map known prefixes (/my/workspaces/new → «برای ساخت پنل، اول وارد شوید؛ بعد به فرم ساخت پنل برمی‌گردید.», /invite/ and /c/ → «برای پاسخ‌دادن به دعوت…»).

pages.task: Invited student understands who invites them, what is shared, and signs in to start
pages.summary: Good sharing explanation, but wrong size of the task (15 questions / 8 min), three competing sign-in buttons and adult/organisation wording for a school student.

findings.issue: For the matrix instrument the meta says «تعداد پرسش ۱۵» and «۸ دقیقه»; the student will write 2-8 fields and rate 15 statements per field, so the promised effort is wrong (expectation breach after consent).
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 conformity with user expectations; ISO 25010 appropriateness recognisability
findings.fix: Add an extension in ts_talent (like tpl_detail_ext) on ts_org.invite: dt «اندازهٔ کار» dd «۱۵ جمله برای هر زمینه؛ ۲ تا ۸ زمینه را خودت می‌نویسی» and time per field.

findings.issue: Three buttons (mobile, create email account, email login) wrap into an uneven cluster; a teen must choose an auth method before starting.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability for the task; Hick's law / NN/g choice overload
findings.fix: One full-width primary «ادامه با شمارهٔ موبایل»; below it one text link «حساب ایمیلی دارم» to login_url (signup by email reachable from login).

findings.issue: Sharing box heading «چه چیزی با سازمان به اشتراک گذاشته می‌شود؟» and «مؤسسه» for a school panel; «شما» for a student.
findings.standard: Persian conventions («تو» for students); ISO 9241-112 consistency (پنل)
findings.fix: Heading «چه چیزی با پنل «<ws name>» دیده می‌شود؟»; in education use «مدرسه و مشاور مسئولت گزارش نتیجه‌ات را می‌بینند…».

findings.issue: No line saying what the inventory is for; the only description is the title.
findings.fix: Add under the h1: inst.intended_use short form, e.g. «زمینه‌هایی را که دوست داری می‌نویسی و می‌بینی در کدام‌ها توانایی بیشتری حس می‌کنی.»

pages.task: Invited counselor accepts a panel invitation
pages.summary: States panel and role, but offers an email signup that will not match a mobile-bound invitation and gives no idea what the role allows.

findings.issue: «ساخت حساب» goes to the email signup even when the invite is bound to a verified mobile; the user then gets «این دعوت برای شمارهٔ موبایل یا ایمیل دیگری صادر شده است» after creating the account.
findings.fix: Show only the method that matches the invite (inv bound to phone → only «ورود با کد پیامکی»; to email → email login/signup), and say which: «این دعوت برای شمارهٔ ۰۹۱۲…۸۹ صادر شده است.» (masked).

findings.issue: No inviter name, no expiry, no link explaining what «مشاور» can see.
findings.fix: Add «دعوت‌کننده: <name>» and «اعتبار تا <jalali date>» and a link «این نقش چه چیزهایی را می‌بیند» to /help/roles.

pages.task: Student opens a class link from the counselor and starts
pages.summary: Unlike /invite, the open link says nothing about who will see the result before asking the student to create an account.

findings.issue: No «چه کسی نتیجه را می‌بیند» block; the student signs up for a panel-linked assessment without knowing the school and counselor will see the report.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 user engagement (informed participation); ISO 9241-110 self-descriptiveness
findings.fix: Extract the sharing box of tpl_invite into a template (ts_org.share_box, param ws) and call it in tpl_campaign_join; presentation only, the consent screen remains the legal step.

findings.issue: Same «تعداد پرسش ۱۵ / ۸ دقیقه» and three-button auth cluster as /invite.
findings.fix: See patterns PT-1 and PT-3.

pages.task: Participant understands what the inventory involves, who sees the result, confirms age/guardian and starts
pages.summary: A success tick before anything is done, an always-visible guardian box with tiny unstyled radios, and a one-line consent that omits stopping, saving and withdrawal.

findings.issue: Consent comprehension: the only consent sentence is «با اجرای این سنجه برای دریافت گزارش فردی موافقم»; unlike the standard consent it does not say answers are saved automatically, that the person can stop and continue later, or how to withdraw consent/delete; no research opt-in distinction.
findings.fix: Add a short dl like the generic consent: «چه کار می‌کنی» (۲ تا ۸ زمینه، ۱۵ جمله برای هر کدام)، «ذخیره» (هر پاسخ خودکار ذخیره می‌شود؛ هر وقت خواستی بیرون برو و بعد ادامه بده)، «انصراف» (هر زمان می‌توانی متوقف شوی؛ حذف از صفحهٔ حریم خصوصی). Consent version bump = owner.

findings.issue: Age question uses native 13 px radios placed on one line («بله ○ خیر…») and the guardian checkbox is always shown, even after «بله», as a third unstyled control; on a phone this is easy to mis-tap and reads as if adults must also confirm a guardian.
findings.standard: WCAG 2.2 2.5.8 (and project 44 px); ISO 9241-143 field grouping/conditional fields; ISO 9241-110 use-error robustness
findings.fix: Style radios as tt-check rows (22 px control, 44 px row, one per line); wrap guardian_ok in a container hidden until age18=no (aria-live region, 5 lines of JS; no-JS keeps it visible). Server validation unchanged.

findings.issue: A large ✓ badge tops the consent screen before anything is done, reading as «already completed».
findings.fix: Remove .tt-badge from tpl_consent (keep it for tpl_between) or replace with a neutral icon.

findings.issue: Register: the whole player addresses a 15-year-old as «شما» («خودتان را … بسنجید», «آیا ۱۸ سال یا بیشتر دارید»), and uses «آزمون» in the guardian line where the product says «سنجه».
findings.standard: Persian conventions («تو» for students, one term per concept)
findings.fix: See pattern PT-2; replace «این آزمون» with «این سنجه».

findings.issue: «حریم خصوصی» link in the fine print is indistinguishable from body text in dark mode; emergency number written «115» (Latin) while footers use «۱۱۵».
findings.fix: Underline links in .tt-mini; write «۱۱۵» (it is a phone number read aloud, not a code).

pages.task: Participant writes the name of the first field (subject, art, sport, skill, job)
pages.summary: Focused one-field screen, but the input has no visible label, the user gets no picture of the whole journey, and the min/max rule sits under the button.

findings.issue: The input's label is visually-hidden; on screen only the placeholder «مثلاً: ریاضی» identifies the field and it disappears on typing.
findings.fix: Make the label visible: «نام زمینه» above the input; keep the example as hint text under it («مثلاً: ریاضی، فوتبال، طراحی لباس»), linked by aria-describedby.

findings.issue: No overview of the journey: the counter says «زمینهٔ ۱» but not how many to do, how long each takes, or that each field brings 15 statements; the «دست‌کم ۲ … حداکثر ۸» rule is after the button.
findings.fix: Counter «زمینهٔ ۱ (۲ تا ۸)»; move the min/max hint above the input and add «برای هر زمینه ۱۵ جمله، حدود ۲ دقیقه. معمولاً ۳ تا ۵ زمینه کافی است.» (recommended count = owner).

findings.issue: A teen has to invent fields from nothing; no suggestions.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 learnability; NN/g recognition over recall
findings.fix: Optional chips under the input (ریاضی، نقاشی، فوتبال، برنامه‌نویسی، موسیقی) that fill the input; hidden for already-used labels.

pages.role: participant ts.pv2.ux.p3 (one field done, second partially rated)
pages.task: Participant rates 15 statements for the current field on a 5-point scale, 5 per page
pages.summary: Large tap targets and autosave, but no question stem for the scale, progress only within the field, save feedback out of view and legends that straddle the card border.

findings.issue: The scale has no question stem: anchors «بسیار کم … بسیار زیاد» are answers to «how much?», but items are statements such as «تا چیزی را که در نقاشی میدانم تجربه نکنم، آرام نمی‌شوم»; the generic player has ts-scale-help, the matrix page has none.
findings.fix:
Add under the steps bar (once per page):

هر جمله چقدر دربارهٔ تو در «نقاشی» درست است؟

; keep the anchors.

findings.issue: Progress shows only the page inside the current field («۱ از ۳»); the participant on field 2 sees no field index and no overall progress, so a 15-year-old cannot judge how much is left.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 self-descriptiveness (state of the system); Nielsen 1 visibility of status
findings.fix: counter = «زمینهٔ ۲ · صفحهٔ ۱ از ۳» (field.sequence); steps bar aria-hidden stays, add visually-hidden text «صفحهٔ ۱ از ۳ زمینهٔ نقاشی».

findings.issue: The legend of each fieldset sits on the card border: the first line of the statement is outside the card and the second inside (fieldset legend default rendering with box-shadow card).
findings.fix: .tt-q legend { float: inline-start; width: 100%; } .tt-q legend + * { clear: both; } (or padding-block-start on .tt-q and legend display:contents with a p inside).

findings.issue: Save feedback («در حال ذخیره…»/«ذخیره شد»/error) is written into .tt-save at the very bottom, after the nav button; on a phone the user never sees it, including the error case.
findings.fix: Move <span class="tt-save" aria-live="polite"> into .tt-bar next to the counter (visible top) and show a small check icon per answered .tt-q (is-answered class already set).

findings.issue: Option text is .72rem (about 11.5 px) bold; «بسیار زیاد» and «بسیار کم» are the smallest text on the screen of the core task; the selected state is a light fill + thin border only.
findings.fix: font-size .85rem with line-break allowed; selected: 2px accent border + a check glyph ::before so the state is not only colour.

findings.issue: Digits 1-5 (and ۱-۵) answer the first unanswered statement even when focus is not in a radio group: a single-character shortcut that cannot be turned off.
findings.fix: Only handle digits when document.activeElement is inside a .tt-q (drop the 'first unanswered' fallback); show the numbers on options (aria-hidden) so the shortcut is discoverable.

findings.issue: Statement text misses نیم‌فاصله and has spacing errors («میتوانم», «ریشه یابی», «می توانم», «طرحهای», «موفق هستم .»).
findings.fix: Correct orthography only (no wording change) in the item data; needs owner OK because items are verbatim from the book.

pages.task: Participant decides to add another field or finish and see the result
pages.summary: The irreversible submit happens in one tap with no check-answers step, no warning that answers lock, and completed fields cannot be opened or corrected.

findings.issue: «پایان و دیدن نتیجه» posts /finish directly; there is no confirmation that answers can no longer be changed and no reminder of who will see the result (the generic review page has both).
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 use-error robustness; GOV.UK check answers pattern; WCAG 2.2 3.3.4 (reversible/confirmed submissions)
findings.fix: Turn tpl_between's finish into a check-answers block: list done fields with «۱۵ از ۱۵» each, line «پس از پایان، پاسخ‌ها تغییر نمی‌کنند.» + who_sees_line, then the finish button «پایان و دیدن نتیجه».

findings.issue: Completed fields are shown as non-interactive pills; a participant who mis-rated or misspelled a field has no way back before finishing.
findings.fix: Make each pill a link «مرور/ویرایش» to the field's pages (needs a route to reopen a done field; engine and audit unchanged until submit).

findings.issue: Counter «۲ زمینه» does not say this is enough to finish or how many more are allowed.
findings.fix: «۲ زمینه کامل؛ تا ۶ زمینهٔ دیگر می‌توانی اضافه کنی» under the pills.

pages.task: Participant checks answers before final submission
pages.summary: The generic Likert review is rendered for a matrix attempt with all fields done: it says 0 of 15 answered, lists raw «این زمینه» items and offers only a link that the matrix player ignores.

findings.issue: For a completed matrix attempt the page claims «۰ از ۱۵ پرسش پاسخ داده شده است», shows the warning that all questions must be answered, lists 15 statements with the raw placeholder «این زمینه», and the only action «رفتن به اولین پرسش بی‌پاسخ» links to ?page=1, a parameter the matrix take() ignores (it uses p), so the user returns to the between screen; no submit is offered. A student believes all answers were lost.
findings.evidence: _p4_review_1280.txt lines 11-31; _p4_review_375.png; ts_talent/controllers/main.py (no review override, take() reads kw['p'])
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 self-descriptiveness and use-error robustness; ISO 25010 user error protection; Nielsen 1
findings.fix: In TsTalent add @http.route() def review(self, token, **kw): if attempt.ts_is_matrix(): redirect to /take/<token> (or render the check-answers block of P15-1); else super(). Same guard for the generic /page and /submit routes.

findings.issue: Page title h1 is the instrument name at hero size (two lines on 375) instead of the task «مرور و ارسال».
findings.fix: h1 «مرور پاسخ‌ها پیش از ارسال», instrument name as kicker (generic review; benefits all instruments).

patterns.issue: Matrix instrument described with item-based meta: «تعداد پرسش ۱۵» and «۸ دقیقه» while the participant writes 2-8 fields and rates 15 statements each; consent says «هر زمینه حدود یک دقیقه».
patterns.fix: One helper on the instrument (ts_talent): effort_label() → «۱۵ جمله برای هر زمینه، ۲ تا ۸ زمینه» and duration_label() → «حدود ۲ دقیقه برای هر زمینه»; extensions on ts_org.invite and ts_panel.campaign_join like tpl_detail_ext; consent copy uses the same strings. Real timing = owner.

patterns.issue: Students are addressed with «شما» across the player, invite and consent.
patterns.fix: Pass a register flag to the player templates (client age_group minor or workspace purpose education → «تو»), with two copy variants in tpl_consent, tpl_name, tpl_statements, tpl_between and the invite sharing box. Copy only; logic unchanged.

patterns.issue: Three equal sign-in buttons on participant/colleague entry pages (mobile, email signup, email login).
patterns.fix: Shared template ts_website.auth_choices(phone_url, login_url, signup_url): one full-width primary for mobile, one text link «حساب ایمیلی دارم»; for /join show only the method the invite is bound to.

patterns.issue: Sign-in loses context and return path: /signup with next= shows no reason; /web/login links to /signup without redirect.
patterns.fix: tpl_signup: ts-notice keyed on next prefix; login_ts: pass redirect to /signup as next.
